clauses.title: Sum Insured
clauses.text: The sum insured is Rs 7,50,000 per policy year, shared by all insured members on a floater basis.

clauses.title: Room Rent
clauses.text: Room rent is payable up to 1% of the sum insured per day. Higher room expenses paid in same proportion.

clauses.title: ICU Charges
clauses.text: ICU charges are payable up to 2% of the sum insured per day.

clauses.title: Co-payment
clauses.text: A co-payment of 20% applies to every admissible claim for an insured member aged 60 years or above.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: A deductible of Rs 10,000 applies to each claim.

clauses.title: Sub-Limits
clauses.text: Cataract payable up to Rs 40,000 per eye. Hernia repair payable up to Rs 60,000.

clauses.title: Initial Waiting Period
clauses.text: Illness claims are not covered in the first 30 days from the policy start date. Accidents are covered from day one.

clauses.title: Pre-existing Diseases
clauses.text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 48 months of continuous cover.

clauses.title: Specific Diseases
clauses.text: Cataract, hernia, joint replacement and kidney stones are covered after 24 months of continuous cover.

clauses.title: Exclusions
clauses.text: Cosmetic surgery, weight-loss surgery and treatment outside India are excluded.

clauses.title: Non-Payable Items
clauses.text: Items on the IRDAI list of non-medical expenses are not payable.

clauses.title: Pre and Post Hospitalisation
clauses.text: Medical expenses are covered for 60 days before admission and 90 days after discharge.

clauses.title: Claim Intimation
clauses.text: Inform the insurer within 24 hours of an emergency admission, and at least 48 hours before a planned admission.

clauses.title: Claim Documents
clauses.text: Submit all claim documents within 15 days of discharge.
